cause.upstream: OSS Insight event-derived ranking is unavailable at roughly 0.3% capture baseline
cause.oldPolicy: OSS primary failure marked GitHub warning even when official Trending and all mandatory evidence succeeded
cause.effect: Daily publication required every current channel to be success, so main remained on 2026-10-13

changes.primary: Official GitHub Trending all-language/Python/TypeScript daily and all-language weekly
changes.optional: Four configured OSS Insight source failures remain truthful source notices
changes.required: Current official rankings, successful active searches, complete exact mandatory repository evidence and no tracked refresh failures
changes.legacyFinalizer: Delegates to the same full reviewer
changes.publicVerification: Large catalogs use a bounded 60-second timeout and at most two attempts; dates, counts and hashes remain mandatory

notices.error: This ranking is ordered by recent star/PR/issue event counts, and our capture of those events fell to roughly 0.3% of baseline, so the ordering would be noise. An empty result here means the metric cannot be computed, not that there are no matching repositories.
